_note: Authored for this benchmark, for the same reason as the RCC set: the released question set is lung-specific. These six use concepts TCGA-BRCA reports record, and mirror the released set's grading plus local-extension structure. A WSI-FiVE result on BRCA is not prompt-faithful.
questions: What is the histologic grade of the carcinoma? (Nottingham/SBR grade 1-3, or Unknown.)
Is there an in-situ carcinoma component accompanying the invasive tumour, and of what type?
Is there any indication of lymphovascular invasion by the carcinoma?
Is there any evidence of tumour involving regional lymph nodes?
Is there tumour necrosis present within the carcinoma?
Are the surgical margins of the excised tissue clear of disease? (note that: R0 means negative; R1 R2 both mean positive; Rx means Unknown.
